label: S. 5515
title: CARE for Moms Act

items.snippet: This bill establishes and expands federal programs to increase access to health care for pregnant and postpartum women, particularly those in underserved communities.
It also increases and expands excise taxes on tobacco products.

items.snippet: …pregnant and postpartum women The bill also allows for two years of postpartum coverage for women under the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC).

items.item: Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
items.snippet: The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) must publish information on Medicaid and CHIP benefits for pregnant and postpartum women and report to Congress on maternal health needs and expenditures.
